mapper.insert: -- Record local-government URL and schedule changes without response bodies or secrets. INSERT INTO audit_logs (actor_user_id, action_code, resource_type, resource_id, result_code, metadata_json) VALUES (#{actorUserId}, #{actionCode}, #{resourceType}, #{resourceId}, #{resultCode}, CAST(#{metadataJson} AS jsonb))
mapper.sql: lgns.id AS source_id, lgns.public_code, lgns.sido_code, lgns.sido_name, lgns.sigungu_code, lgns.sigungu_name, lgns.institution_type_code, lgns.institution_name, lgns.homepage_url, lgns.notice_url, lgns.collection_endpoint_url, lgns.page_type_code, lgns.request_profile_code, lgns.request_method_code, lgns.request_form_json::text AS request_form_json, lgns.parser_profile_code, lgnpp.profile_name AS parser_profile_name, lgns.collection_hint, lgns.confidence_code, lgns.validation_status_code, lgns.is_enabled, lgns.collection_status_code, lgns.last_collected_at, lgns.last_success_at, lgns.last_http_status, lgns.last_error_code, lgns.last_error_message, lgns.etag, lgns.last_modified_value, lgns.last_content_fingerprint, lgns.created_at, lgns.updated_at, lgns.deleted_at

ass.id AS schedule_id, ass.public_code, ass.provider_code, ass.schedule_name, ass.cron_expression, ass.timezone, ass.schedule_status_code, ass.max_count, ass.requested_by, ass.approved_by, ass.approved_at, ass.approval_note, ass.last_run_at, ass.next_run_at, ass.created_at, ass.updated_at
mapper.insert: -- Register a local-government notice source in disabled state. INSERT INTO local_government_notice_sources ( id, sido_code, sido_name, sigungu_code, sigungu_name, institution_type_code, institution_name, homepage_url, notice_url, collection_endpoint_url, page_type_code, request_profile_code, parser_profile_code, collection_hint, confidence_code, validation_status_code, is_enabled, collection_status_code, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{sourceId}, #{sidoCode}, #{sidoName}, #{sigunguCode}, #{sigunguName}, #{institutionTypeCode}, #{institutionName}, #{homepageUrl}, #{noticeUrl}, #{collectionEndpointUrl}, #{pageTypeCode}, #{requestProfileCode}, #{parserProfileCode}, #{collectionHint}, #{confidenceCode}, #{validationStatusCode}, false, 'CHECK_REQUIRED', #{actorUserId}, #{actorUserId} )
mapper.update: -- Update local-government notice source metadata without changing ON/OFF. UPDATE local_government_notice_sources SET sido_code = #{sidoCode}, sido_name = #{sidoName}, sigungu_code = #{sigunguCode}, sigungu_name = #{sigunguName}, institution_type_code = #{institutionTypeCode}, institution_name = #{institutionName}, homepage_url = #{homepageUrl}, notice_url = #{noticeUrl}, collection_endpoint_url = #{collectionEndpointUrl}, page_type_code = #{pageTypeCode}, request_profile_code = #{requestProfileCode}, parser_profile_code = #{parserProfileCode}, collection_hint = #{collectionHint}, confidence_code = #{confidenceCode}, validation_status_code = #{validationStatusCode}, collection_status_code = CASE WHEN #{validationStatusCode} = 'VERIFIED' THEN 'READY' ELSE 'CHECK_REQUIRED' END, updated_by = #{actorUserId}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{sourceId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

-- Enable only a verified source with an executable parser profile. UPDATE local_government_notice_sources SET is_enabled = #{enabled}, collection_status_code = CASE WHEN #{enabled} THEN 'READY' ELSE 'DISABLED' END, updated_by = #{actorUserId}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{sourceId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND ( NOT #{enabled} OR ( validation_status_code = 'VERIFIED' AND parser_profile_code IS NOT NULL AND parser_profile_code <> 'MANUAL_ONLY' ) )

-- Soft delete a local-government notice source and stop collection. UPDATE local_government_notice_sources SET is_enabled = false, collection_status_code = 'DISABLED', deleted_at = now(), updated_by = #{actorUserId}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{sourceId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select:
-- Select local-government notice source registry. SELECT FROM local_government_notice_sources lgns LEFT JOIN local_government_notice_parser_profiles lgnpp ON lgnpp.profile_code = lgns.parser_profile_code
ORDER BY lgns.sido_name ASC, lgns.sigungu_name ASC, lgns.public_code ASC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
-- Count local-government notice source registry. SELECT count(1) FROM local_government_notice_sources lgns

-- Select local-government notice source details. SELECT FROM local_government_notice_sources lgns LEFT JOIN local_government_notice_parser_profiles lgnpp ON lgnpp.profile_code = lgns.parser_profile_code WHERE lgns.id = #{sourceId} AND lgns.deleted_at IS NULL

-- Select parser profiles available to operators. SELECT profile_code, profile_name, parser_type_code, list_item_selector, title_selector, date_selector, link_selector, date_pattern, response_type_code, json_items_path, json_title_field, json_date_field, json_link_field, json_link_template, link_strategy_code, link_function_name, link_function_argument_count, link_url_template, is_enabled FROM local_government_notice_parser_profiles ORDER BY profile_name ASC, profile_code ASC

-- Select parser profile details for a collection attempt. SELECT profile_code, profile_name, parser_type_code, list_item_selector, title_selector, date_selector, link_selector, date_pattern, response_type_code, json_items_path, json_title_field, json_date_field, json_link_field, json_link_template, link_strategy_code, link_function_name, link_function_argument_count, link_url_template, is_enabled FROM local_government_notice_parser_profiles WHERE profile_code = #{profileCode}

-- Aggregate local-government source and review traffic-light counts. SELECT count(1) FILTER (WHERE lgns.deleted_at IS NULL) AS total_count, count(1) FILTER (WHERE lgns.deleted_at IS NULL AND lgns.is_enabled = true) AS enabled_count, count(1) FILTER (WHERE lgns.deleted_at IS NULL AND lgns.collection_status_code IN ('SUCCESS', 'NO_CHANGE')) AS success_count, count(1) FILTER (WHERE lgns.deleted_at IS NULL AND lgns.collection_status_code IN ('CHECK_REQUIRED', 'READY', 'DISABLED')) AS warning_count, count(1) FILTER (WHERE lgns.deleted_at IS NULL AND lgns.collection_status_code IN ('FAILED', 'URL_ERROR', 'ACCESS_BLOCKED', 'PARSER_UNSUPPORTED')) AS failed_count, (SELECT count(1) FROM announcement_source_snapshots ass WHERE ass.provider_code = 'LOCAL_GOV_NOTICE' AND ass.review_status_code IN ('REVIEW_PENDING', 'CONDITION_INPUT_REQUIRED')) AS review_pending_count FROM local_government_notice_sources lgns
mapper.insert: -- Store one collection result for each local-government URL in a run. INSERT INTO announcement_source_collection_source_results ( id, run_id, local_government_source_id, result_status_code, discovered_count, new_count, duplicate_count, failed_count, http_status, error_code, error_message, finished_at ) VALUES ( #{resultId}, #{runId}, #{sourceId}, #{resultStatusCode}, #{discoveredCount}, #{newCount}, #{duplicateCount}, #{failedCount}, #{httpStatus}, #{errorCode}, #{errorMessage}, now() ) ON CONFLICT (run_id, local_government_source_id) DO UPDATE SET result_status_code = excluded.result_status_code, discovered_count = excluded.discovered_count, new_count = excluded.new_count, duplicate_count = excluded.duplicate_count, failed_count = excluded.failed_count, http_status = excluded.http_status, error_code = excluded.error_code, error_message = excluded.error_message, finished_at = excluded.finished_at, updated_at = now()
mapper.update: -- Accumulate new and duplicate item counts after unified duplicate checks. UPDATE announcement_source_collection_source_results SET new_count = new_count + #{newIncrement}, duplicate_count = duplicate_count + #{duplicateIncrement}, updated_at = now() WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND local_government_source_id = #{sourceId}

-- Update last collection metadata without storing response bodies. UPDATE local_government_notice_sources SET collection_status_code = #{collectionStatusCode}, last_collected_at = now(), last_success_at = CASE WHEN #{success} THEN now() ELSE last_success_at END, last_http_status = #{httpStatus}, last_error_code = #{errorCode}, last_error_message = #{errorMessage}, etag = coalesce(#{etag}, etag), last_modified_value = coalesce(#{lastModifiedValue}, last_modified_value), last_content_fingerprint = coalesce(#{contentFingerprint}, last_content_fingerprint), updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{sourceId}
mapper.select: -- Select collection schedules. SELECT FROM announcement_source_collection_schedules ass ORDER BY ass.created_at DESC, ass.public_code DESC
-- Select collection schedule details. SELECT FROM announcement_source_collection_schedules ass WHERE ass.id = #{scheduleId}
mapper.update: -- Apply server-validated schedule approval, pause, rejection, or expiry. UPDATE announcement_source_collection_schedules SET schedule_status_code = #{scheduleStatusCode}, approved_by = CASE WHEN #{scheduleStatusCode} = 'APPROVED' THEN #{actorUserId} ELSE approved_by END, approved_at = CASE WHEN #{scheduleStatusCode} = 'APPROVED' THEN now() ELSE approved_at END, approval_note = #{approvalNote}, next_run_at = #{nextRunAt}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{scheduleId}
mapper.select: -- Select due approved schedules; execution-slot uniqueness prevents duplicate execution. SELECT FROM announcement_source_collection_schedules ass WHERE ass.provider_code = 'LOCAL_GOV_NOTICE' AND ass.schedule_status_code = 'APPROVED' AND ass.next_run_at IS NOT NULL AND ass.next_run_at <= #{dueAt} ORDER BY ass.next_run_at ASC, ass.id ASC LIMIT 10
mapper.update: -- Update schedule execution result. UPDATE announcement_source_schedule_executions SET request_id = coalesce(#{requestId}, request_id), run_id = coalesce(#{runId}, run_id), execution_status_code = #{executionStatusCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{executionId}

-- Advance approved schedule after one claimed run. UPDATE announcement_source_collection_schedules SET last_run_at = #{lastRunAt}, next_run_at = #{nextRunAt}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{scheduleId} AND schedule_status_code = 'APPROVED'
mapper.select: -- Block QA cleanup when a collected local-government source is linked to an operational announcement. SELECT count(1) FROM announcement_source_links asl INNER JOIN announcement_source_snapshots ass ON ass.id = asl.source_id WHERE ass.provider_code = 'LOCAL_GOV_NOTICE'
mapper.delete: -- Delete local-government schedule execution history before request and run history. DELETE FROM announcement_source_schedule_executions asse WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM announcement_source_collection_schedules ascs WHERE ascs.id = asse.schedule_id AND ascs.provider_code = 'LOCAL_GOV_NOTICE' ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM announcement_source_collection_requests ascr WHERE ascr.id = asse.request_id AND ascr.provider_code = 'LOCAL_GOV_NOTICE' )

-- Delete local-government collection runs; run items and source results cascade from the run. DELETE FROM announcement_source_collection_runs ascrun WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM announcement_source_collection_requests ascr WHERE ascr.id = ascrun.request_id AND ascr.provider_code = 'LOCAL_GOV_NOTICE' )
-- Delete local-government collection approval requests after their runs are removed. DELETE FROM announcement_source_collection_requests WHERE provider_code = 'LOCAL_GOV_NOTICE'
-- Delete unlinked local-government source snapshots; dependent review data cascades. DELETE FROM announcement_source_snapshots WHERE provider_code = 'LOCAL_GOV_NOTICE'
mapper.update: -- Reset collection runtime metadata while preserving URL registry and verified parser settings. UPDATE local_government_notice_sources SET collection_status_code = CASE WHEN is_enabled THEN 'READY' ELSE 'DISABLED' END, last_collected_at = NULL, last_success_at = NULL, last_http_status = NULL, last_error_code = NULL, last_error_message = NULL, etag = NULL, last_modified_value = NULL, last_content_fingerprint = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
